title: Answer and ask adj records in ork

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Closes parity rows 6.2 and 4.3 and the "Answer and ask adj records in ork" gap (docs/orchestrator-parity.md, sections 4 and 6; the Prioritized gaps table, gap 7). Today ork calls `adj check`, `ask` and `decide --by` only when a role's question carries a decision key and the owner turned filing on (`internal/engine/answer_adj.go:34-60`, `internal/adjcli/adjcli.go:111-154`). The Questions and Decisions views show open adj records read-only (`docs/dashboard.md:1018-1019`: "An adj answer path is outside this view's current scope"). The owner answers an open record, or asks a new one, in another session.

Owner decisions 2026-10-29:
- This gap is v1.0 (everything except S173, S179 and S180 is).
- ork answers an adj record with `adj decide --by <owner> --why <text that cites ork and the date>`, and only for an option or a typed answer the owner gave in a prompt that names it. ork never runs `adj reject` or `adj supersede` (`process.owner-answers`, #170; `AGENTS.md`, Decisions). `internal/adjcli/adjcli.go` has no function for either, and this slice adds none.

Facts checked on 2026-10-29:
- `adj ask TITLE [--option LABEL:SUMMARY]... [--tradeoffs LABEL:TEXT]... [--recommend LABEL] [--reasoning TEXT] [--key K] [--tag T]... [--ref R]... [--context TEXT] [--by NAME]` prints the new id. `adj decide ID OPTION --why TEXT [--by NAME]` takes one of the record's option labels, or `--text TEXT` for a free answer. `adj show ID --json` prints one record. `adj check QUERY` gives `decided`, `open`, `closed` or `not found` on line 1. (`adj ask --help`, `adj decide --help`, `adj show --help`, `adj check --help`, read 2026-10-29.)
- `Client.Ask` (`adjcli.go:137-148`) sends only title, key, one ref, context and `--by`; it has no options. `Client.Decide` (`adjcli.go:150-154`) sends only `--text`. Both stay as they are for `fileDecision`; this slice adds siblings.
- The owner's name comes from the caller's `ADJ_DECIDED_BY`, sent over the wire as `by` (`internal/tui/model.go:1391`, `internal/cli/wave.go:256`). The daemon refuses a decide without it (`internal/daemon/runs.go:915-917`).
- The record pane of the Questions and Decisions views is read-only and reads the snapshot (`internal/tui/decisions.go:216-248`; `m.decisionPane`, `internal/tui/questions.go:67-81`). Digits there jump to a project today.
- `docs/boundaries.md:70-73`: `adj decide` runs only on an explicit owner action, as the owner. This slice keeps that: no role and no automatic step calls the new methods.
- Before asking, check (`AGENTS.md`, Decisions): a keyed ask runs `adj check KEY` first and stops on `decided`, `open` or `closed`.

Decided records that apply: `scope.v1` (#1) says roadmap and decision editing wait for a later version; the owner's 2026-10-29 decision moves this gap into v1.0, and the owner records that against #1.

What this slice adds (all *proposed* until an adj record decides it):
- adjcli: `Show`, `AskQuestion` (options, tradeoffs, recommendation, refs, tags) and `DecideOption`.
- engine: `AnswerRecord` and `AskRecord` as package functions in `internal/engine/adjrecord.go` (new), beside `fileDecision`.
- Daemon methods `adj.answer` and `adj.ask`; the project must use adj. After either, the Open and Decided parts are read again.
- `ork adj answer PROJECT ID (--option LABEL | --text TEXT)`: prints the question and options, then asks `Decide #ID as LABEL in adj as NAME? [y/N]`. Enter and closed input are No. There is no `--yes` (see Open 2).
- `ork adj ask PROJECT TITLE [--key K] [--context TEXT|-] [--option LABEL:SUMMARY]... [--tradeoffs LABEL:TEXT]... [--recommend LABEL] [--reasoning TEXT] [--ref R]... [--tag T]...`: no prompt, because asking decides nothing.
- TUI: in an open record's detail pane (Questions view, Decisions Open tab), `1`-`4` pick that option and `t` types a free answer. Both end in the confirmation bar `Decide #12 as "label" in adj as NAME? [y/N] (Enter is No)`. `y` sends. Without `ADJ_DECIDED_BY` the keys say so and send nothing. A decided record shows no answer keys.

Not in this slice: a TUI form to ask a new record (Open 1), `adj amend`, `withdraw`, `reject` and `supersede` (the owner runs those), answering a record of a project that does not use adj, and filing a role question in adj (that is `fileDecision`, unchanged).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestAdjClientShowAskAndDecideOption` (`internal/adjcli/adjcli_test.go`): `Show` runs `show ID --json --root R`; `AskQuestion` builds `ask TITLE --key K --context C --option a:A --option b:B --tradeoffs a:T --recommend a --reasoning R --ref X --by NAME` and returns the id; `DecideOption` builds `decide ID LABEL --why W --by NAME`. A source scan of `adjcli.go` finds no `"reject"`, `"supersede"` or `"withdraw"` argument.
- `TestAnswerRecordPicksAnOptionOrTypesText` (`internal/engine/adjrecord_test.go`): an option label runs `decide ID LABEL`; `Text` runs `decide ID --text T`; the `--why` names ork, the surface (`tui` or `cli`) and the date from `Deps.Now`; `--by` is the caller's name.
- `TestAnswerRecordRefusals` (`internal/engine/adjrecord_test.go`): blank `by`, both or neither of option and text, a label that is not in the record's options, and a record that is not open each stop before any `decide` call, with the record's status in the message.
- `TestAskRecordChecksTheKeyBeforeAsking` (`internal/engine/adjrecord_test.go`): a key that `adj check` reports as `decided`, `open` or `closed` refuses with the record id and makes no `ask` call; `not found` asks; no key skips the check.
- `TestAskRecordRefusals` (`internal/engine/adjrecord_test.go`): blank title, one option, five options, a recommendation that is not an option label, and `--reasoning` without a recommendation are refused before any call.
- `TestAdjMethodsDecideAskAndRefresh` (`internal/daemon/adjwrite_test.go`): `adj.answer` and `adj.ask` run through the fake adj, then the Open and Decided parts are read again; subtests: a project without adj gives `bad_params`, an unknown project `not_found`, an unknown field `bad_params`, and an adj error keeps its text and hides argv (as `answerError`, `adjcli.go:156-162`).
- `TestAdjAnswerCommandConfirmsBeforeDeciding` (`internal/cli/adj_test.go`): the command prints the record's title and options, then the prompt; `y` calls `adj.answer` once; `n`, Enter and closed input call nothing and exit 0 with `cancelled`; a record not in the project's open list exits 1; `ADJ_DECIDED_BY` unset exits 1 before the prompt; there is no `--yes` flag.
- `TestAdjAskCommand` (`internal/cli/adj_test.go`): `ork adj ask P "Title" --key a.b --option x:X --option y:Y --recommend x --reasoning R` sends the params and prints the new id; `--json` prints `{"id":12}`; a key `adj check` knows exits 1 with the existing id; bad `--option` text (no colon) exits 2.
- `TestDecisionPaneNumberKeyConfirmsThenDecides` (`internal/tui/decisionanswer_test.go`): in an open record's pane `2` opens the confirmation naming record, label and name; `n` and Enter cancel with no write; `y` calls `AdjAnswer` once, closes the pane, says `decided in adj as #12` and fetches the project.
- `TestDecisionPaneFreeTextAndMissingDecidedBy` (`internal/tui/decisionanswer_test.go`): `t` opens a text field (`+`, `-` and `q` type into it), `enter` leads to the same confirmation; with `ADJ_DECIDED_BY` unset every answer key says so and sends nothing.
- `TestDecisionPaneHintsFollowTheRecord` (`internal/tui/decisionanswer_test.go`): the hint line lists `1-N pick` and `t free text` only for an open record in a project with adj and a daemon; a decided record, a pane in a project without adj, and a nil daemon list neither; `?` help names the keys.
- `TestGoldenDecisionAnswerConfirm` (`internal/tui/decisionanswer_test.go`): the confirmation bar over the record pane at 100x30, colour and mono.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
UI slice: UI pass (r14). It touches `internal/tui`, `internal/cli` output and `docs/dashboard.md`. Write the failing tests first. Steps 1-6 do not touch the TUI and can land and be checked on their own.

1. `internal/adjcli/adjcli.go`: add `Client.Show(ctx, root, id int) (*Record, error)` (`adj show ID --json --root R`, a read like `Inbox`, `adjcli.go:88`), `AskSpec{Title, Key, Context, By, Recommend, Reasoning string; Options []AskOption; Refs, Tags []string}` with `AskOption{Label, Summary, Tradeoffs string}`, `Client.AskQuestion(ctx, w, root, spec) (int, error)`, and `Client.DecideOption(ctx, w, root, id int, label, why, by string) error`. Build them on `c.write` (`adjcli.go:104-109`) and decode the id as `Ask` does (`adjcli.go:137-148`); keep `answerError` (`adjcli.go:156-162`) around every result so argv stays out of messages. Add no reject, supersede or withdraw function.
2. `internal/engine/adjrecord.go` (new, SPDX line first): `AnswerRecordConfig{Project registry.Project; ID int; Option, Text, By, Via string}` and `AnswerRecord(ctx, d Deps, cfg) (string, error)`. Order: `by` not blank; exactly one of Option and Text; `d.Adj.Show`; status must be `open`; an Option must equal one option label exactly. `why` = `"Answered in ork (" + Via + ") on " + date + ": " + record.Title`. Then `DecideOption` or `Decide` (`adjcli.go:150`). Return `"decided in adj as #ID"` as `fileDecision` does (`answer_adj.go:55-60`). Also `AskRecordConfig` and `AskRecord(ctx, d Deps, cfg) (id int, err error)`: validate (title; 0 options, or 2-4; recommend names an option; reasoning needs a recommend), then with a key run `d.Adj.Check` (`adjcli.go:111`) and refuse any state but `not found`, then `AskQuestion`. Use `runrec.Writer{Now: d.now, Sleep: d.Sleep, Backoff: d.Backoff}` with no Sink (`speccheck.go:373`).
3. `internal/daemon/wire.go:17-33` and `internal/daemon/adjwrite.go` (new): `MethodAdjAnswer = "adj.answer"` and `MethodAdjAsk = "adj.ask"` (*proposed*); `AdjAnswerParams{Project string; ID int; Option, Text, By, Via string}` with result `{Message string}`; `AdjAskParams` (title, key, context, options, recommend, reasoning, refs, tags, by) with result `{ID int}`. Handlers: `d.registered` (`reads.go:77`), refuse `!proj.Adj` with `badParams`, call the engine function with `d.runDeps(proj)` (`runs.go:159`), then `d.cache.Refresh(ctx, proj, source.Open, source.Decided)`. Dispatch in `handlers.go:61-170`; `Client.AdjAnswer` and `Client.AdjAsk` beside `AnswerAction` (`client.go:284-296`).
4. `internal/cli/adj.go` (new): `ork adj answer` and `ork adj ask` as in Why. `answer` reads the project's open records from `snapshot` (`daemon.MethodSnapshot`, `SnapshotResult.Open`, `wire.go:218-231`) to print the title and options, then prompts on `a.Input` the way `ork run` does (`run.go:67-98`; Enter and closed input are No, a No prints `cancelled` and exits 0). `by` = `ADJ_DECIDED_BY` for answer; for ask `ADJ_ASKED_BY`, else `ADJ_DECIDED_BY`, else empty (adj accepts an empty asker). `Via` is `cli`. Usage text and dispatch: `cli.go:40-77`, `cli.go:173-205`.
5. Docs for the CLI: `docs/design.md:1205-1240` (the `adj answer` and `adj ask` commands, `adj.answer` and `adj.ask`, and that `answer` has no `--yes`), `docs/boundaries.md:70-73` (the explicit owner action now also covers answering a record in ork; still no reject or supersede).
6. Checkpoint: run the engine, daemon, cli and adjcli tests green before the TUI.
7. `internal/tui/decisionanswer.go` (new): optional interface `adjAnswerer { AdjAnswer(ctx, daemon.AdjAnswerParams) (string, error) }` (as `laterFiler`, `findings.go:18-22`) and `Daemon.AdjAnswer` (`daemon.go:207-215` shows the shape). `decisionKey(msg)` runs from `Model.key` before the generic switch (`model.go:482-540`) when `m.decisionPane != nil` and the record is open: `1`-`N` (N = number of options, at most 4) build a `runAction{verb: "decide"}` with the label and record id and set `m.confirm`; `t` opens a `textField`; `enter` there builds the same action from the typed text. Reuse the confirm flow (`model.go:507-521`). Extend `runAction` (`model.go:1120-1138`) with `adjID int` and `option string`; add `decide` to `command()` and `prompt()` (`model.go:1179-1230`: command `ork adj answer PROJECT ID --option "LABEL"`, then `Decide #ID as "LABEL" in adj as NAME? [y/N] (Enter is No)`), `confirmWord` (`keys.go:187-201`: `decide`), and `pendingText`/`doneText` (`card.go:591-654`). `callAction` (`model.go:1418-1470`) gets a `decide` case that calls `adjAnswerer`; key the flight by `adj:PROJECT#ID`, not by run, and let the `actionMsg` handler (`model.go:360`) treat an empty run row as no run pane to update. `by` = `os.Getenv("ADJ_DECIDED_BY")`; blank means the key sets the status `ADJ_DECIDED_BY is unset; set it before answering in adj` and sends nothing. On success close the pane, set the status from the reply and `m.fetch(project, true)`.
8. `internal/tui/keys.go`: `PickAdj`/`FreeAdj` bindings or reuse `PickOption` and `FreeAnswer` with enabled checks; in the record-pane hint (`keys.go:321-329`) add `offer(answerable, ..., "1-N", "pick")` and `t free text`; `FullHelp` (`keys.go:122-131`) already lists them. The answerable check is one function used by the key and the hint (as `fileRefusal` is): open record, `reg.Adj`, daemon connected, `Live` has `adjAnswerer`. `projectTextEntry` (`projects.go:23-27`) is true while the free-text field is open. In `recordDetailLines` (`decisions.go:216-248`) number the option lines `1.` to `4.` only when the record is answerable, so the keys are visible.
9. Docs for the TUI: `docs/dashboard.md:1004-1038` (replace "An adj answer path is outside this view's current scope" and "`a`, `x`, `t` and `c` have no action on ... read-only record detail"), `docs/dashboard.md:1332-1418` (the heading `Decisions (one project or all, read-only in v1)`, "There is no run cursor or write action on this screen", "Opening a record makes no additional adj call": opening is still local; answering is the one write). Goldens: `go test ./internal/tui -update`, then read the diff in `testdata/golden/`; only the two new `decision-answer-confirm-*` files and, if option numbering changed them, `decisions-100x30-*.txt` and `questions-100x30-*.txt` may change.

Order: independent of the other gap slices. It shares `keys.go`, `model.go` and `cli.go` with S170 and S171 and with S166 to S169; merge main before the gate. If S170 and S171 have landed, `decisionKey` is a sibling of `composeKey`, not a replacement.

Open (for the owner; the defaults below are what the steps above implement):
1. Does this slice include a TUI form to ask a new record? Options: (A) no, `ork adj ask` is the only way to ask (default; recommended: the form needs a multi-option editor and this slice is already larger than M); (B) yes, `n` on the Questions and Decisions Open views opens a form (title, key, context, up to four option lines, a recommendation); (C) a minimal form with title and context only, no options.
2. Does `ork adj answer` take `--yes`? Options: (A) no, it always prompts (default; recommended: an agent that runs `ork adj answer ... --yes` would decide for the owner, which `process.owner-answers` forbids); (B) yes, like `ork run --yes`, so scripts can answer.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go test -race -count=1 ./...`
- `go vet ./...`
- `gofmt -l .` (prints nothing)
- `go test ./internal/tui -update`, then review the diff in `testdata/golden/`
- `slicer check --root /Users/jon/code/squalor-xyz/ork`
- `adj lint --root /Users/jon/code/squalor-xyz/ork`
- No live check against the ork project's adj store: a decide is permanent. Daemon and CLI tests use the fake adj; a manual try uses a throwaway project with its own `.adjudicate.json`.
